item.title: A Sadist Cap [Seeking Greenlight]
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes?

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: My SCP is a dunce cap that can telepathically talk to their victims and tricks them that it's a higher being, and if they do what it demands, they'll be gifted eternal salvation. When the victim completes their task(s), the SCP disappears and leaves them, so they can suffer for what they have done. (So basically, it's a troll)

Central Narrative: In 1990, a man was found dead in his house from suicide. One of his friends went to check on him and saw that the door was unlocked. He decided to enter the house and noticed there were multiple drawings all over the walls and hand-made wooden objects related to the SCP scattered around the room. There was also a message on one of the walls that say this,

"I Don't Understand. I Did Everything It Wanted Me To Do, But I Don't Hear It Anymore. I Made It My God. I Pushed Everyone Away From My Life. I Killed My Own Two Kids For It, And Yet It's Abandons Me. I Guess My Fate Wasn't Good Enough…"

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The cap can somehow teleport to different places in the world, causing more harm to others. The cap does these things to people because it finds it entertaining. The SCP only goes after religious people.

Additional Notes: This might be a boring and cringy SCP idea, so go easy on me lol. (But seriously though, any critique is helpful.)

I don't think I represented my central narrative the right way, but the story is going to be around addendums, interviews, and incidents.

Should I change the object the SCP is? I don't think a dunce cap would fit too well. it seems silly IMO…
